p: Anchorage Capital is a SEBI-registered Category II Alternative Investment Fund, founded by Rohit Kothari and in operation since 2022. It is managed by Anchorage Alpha Investments Advisor Private Limited.

The fund invests across growth companies in India, largely in the unlisted private space and selectively in listed companies. The theme underlying every investment is the same: businesses that are unique in their space, with a decisive moat, backed by exceptional founders.

legacy.h: Twenty-five years before the first scheme.
p: Anchorage Alpha is built upon the investing heritage of the Kothari family office, led by Rohit Kothari. For more than 25 years, the family has invested its own capital across Indian businesses spanning small, mid and large-cap companies, identifying opportunities early, taking a long-term view and holding through cycles.

This heritage of experience, deep relationships and disciplined capital allocation continues to shape Anchorage Alpha today. The sponsor group commits significant capital alongside investors in every scheme.

Rohit Kothari brings more than two decades of investing experience across Indian and global markets, with a track record spanning multiple market cycles. His investment approach centres on identifying enduring businesses, backing high-quality entrepreneurs and compounding value over the long term.

With a strong history of entrepreneurship and operational excellence, he built and scaled Aroni Chemicals and Gwalior Chemicals into the world's second-largest producers of aluminium chloride and chlorotoluenes, acquired by Atofina of France in 2004 and LANXESS of Germany in 2008. In 2008, he founded Antique Stock Broking Limited, a leading mid-market brokerage and investment bank.
Today, he serves as Founder & Executive Chairman of Anchorage Alpha, bringing together the perspective of an investor and entrepreneur.

approach.p: A company in a high-growth phase, where capital helps it grow faster. What matters is growth compounded over years, not one good year.
Every business has to be unique in its space, with a moat strong enough to protect that compounding.
Exceptional leadership and committed founders. On this, there is no compromise.
We would rather originate and lead than follow a crowded round.
Capital has to earn a high return on equity, and the entry value has to leave room for it. In the end, cash flow is king.
We know the sector and the company well, long before we commit.

feat.name: Nxtra
feat.tag: Best-in-Class Execution at Scale in India’s AI Infrastructure Build-Out.
pts: Bharti Airtel’s data centre platform and India’s largest data centre network, with 14 core and 120+ edge facilities nationwide, combining scaled infrastructure with Airtel’s broader ecosystem advantage.
Scaling from ~300 MW towards 1 GW of AI-ready capacity, led by a high-calibre management team and positioned at the convergence of AI, cloud adoption and data localisation.
Anchorage invested behind Nxtra’s proven execution and scale, with Alpha Wave Global and Carlyle among the other co-investors in Nxtra’s ~US$1 billion fundraise.
feat.q: Anchorage brings a valuable global perspective on AI, compute and digital infrastructure, coupled with a strong understanding of how these themes are evolving in India. Their perspective adds real value as we build for the next generation of digital infrastructure.

feat.name: Meril Life Sciences
pts: India’s largest medical devices company and a global innovator, with integrated R&D and manufacturing across cardiovascular, orthopaedics, surgical robotics and other advanced medical device categories, including pioneering indigenous technologies such as coronary stents and the Myval TAVR platform.

Anchorage identified MedTech early as a secular growth opportunity, underpinned by strong healthcare tailwinds and an inflection akin to India’s IT sector, backing Meril and its founders at an early stage of their global growth journey.
Among Meril’s earliest institutional backers, Anchorage invested alongside Warburg Pincus in 2022 at a ~US$1.8 billion valuation. In 2025 ADIA invested at a ~US$6.6 billion valuation.
feat.q: Our relationship with Rohit and Anchorage spans over 25 years, grounded in trust and a shared long-term vision. They understood what we were building long before its scale was evident, and have remained a trusted partner through our journey.
feat.role: Co-founder & Chairman, Meril Life Sciences Group

feat.name: Neysa Networks
feat.tag: Early Access to India’s AI Compute Layer.
pts: Founded by Sharad Sanghi, a pioneer of India’s commercial data centre industry, bringing deep pedigree in building and scaling digital infrastructure.
Positioned at the heart of India’s AI build-out, providing sovereign, production-grade AI infrastructure for mission-critical enterprise and government workloads.
One of India’s select AI cloud platforms working with both NVIDIA and AMD, with the capability to deploy and operate GPU infrastructure at scale.

Anchorage identified and backed Neysa at a formative stage, with the platform subsequently attracting a ~US$1.2 billion Blackstone-led capital commitment to accelerate AI infrastructure deployment across India.
feat.q: Anchorage saw the scale of the opportunity in Neysa before we fully appreciated it. Their conviction in what the business could become was striking at the time, and the journey since has demonstrated the foresight behind that view.

feat.name: Precision Wires
feat.tag: Growth Capital Behind an Electrification Leader.
pts: One of Asia’s leading winding wire manufacturers, with a track record spanning over three decades and exposure across Power, EVs, Renewables and Data Centres.
Anchorage invested at a key inflection point in India’s electrification cycle, drawing on a deep familiarity with the sector.
Growth capital deployed across multiple rounds enabled a record capex programme, accelerating capacity expansion and driving a step-change in earnings growth.
feat.q: Our relationship with the Kotharis goes back three decades, well beyond investment. They have backed us consistently through successive phases of growth and capital raising, the kind of steadfast partnership that is rare to find.

feat.name: ACE Insurance Brokers
feat.tag: Backing a High-Return Specialist in Complex Risk.
pts: Leading Indian insurance broking and risk advisory platform, with over two decades of experience and an integrated offering spanning corporate insurance, risk management and reinsurance.
A capital-light, exceptionally high-margin model with superior ROCE, where specialist domain knowledge, complex risk structuring and deep client relationships create a durable competitive moat.
Anchorage invested in ACE for its specialist franchise and exceptional economics. Blackstone holds a majority stake in the business.
feat.q: Anchorage was our first investment partner and understood the quality and potential of our business early. They have been a thoughtful partner through our evolution, supporting us as we scaled and entered our next phase of institutional growth.

feat.name: Enviro Infra Engineers
feat.tag: From Nascent Player to Water Infrastructure Leader.
pts: Integrated water infrastructure player spanning sewage, industrial wastewater and recycling, with in-house capabilities across process design and execution; expanding into Desalination and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) for its next phase of growth.

Positioned in a ₹20 trillion (~US$240 billion) decade-long opportunity, as water becomes an increasingly critical resource across industries, driven by infrastructure investment, industrial demand and tightening wastewater norms.

Anchorage identified the water infrastructure opportunity early, backing Enviro at a nascent stage, well ahead of broader market recognition, and supporting its evolution from a small player into a scaled water infrastructure platform.
feat.q: Anchorage recognised the potential of water resource management well before most, and backed us at a very early stage in our journey. The conviction with which they put in capital gave us the confidence to pursue a much larger opportunity and accelerate our growth.

feat.name: Thriveni Earthmovers
feat.tag: Backing a Formidable Operator in Critical Minerals.
pts: Built by Mr. B. Prabhakaran, one of the most dynamic and respected founders in the resources sector, Thriveni has grown into an integrated resources platform and is today part of the broader Lloyds Metals & Energy ecosystem.

Positioned across resources critical to industrial growth and the AI economy, spanning iron ore, coal, copper and cobalt, with projects across India and DR Congo and an upcoming project in Papua New Guinea.
Proven turnaround specialist, with a track record of bringing stalled mines to life and rapidly scaling production: a distinctive execution edge in a complex sector.

Anchorage backed Thriveni for its exceptional execution, strong return ratios and significant growth optionality, with several opportunities identified at investment already translating into live projects.
feat.q: Anchorage brings a depth of understanding of the resources sector that is unusual for an investor. Their ability to understand the operating realities of our business and engage with us from that perspective makes them a highly valued partner.

feat.name: Qi Cap
feat.tag: Ahead of the Curve on AI-Native Asset Management.
pts: Founded by Amit Rathi, bringing multi-decade experience across capital and commodity markets and deep expertise in systematic investing.

Global deeptech platform built around proprietary AI/ML alpha engines and self-learning strategies, combining advanced data science with institutional-scale, low-latency execution; processing ~500 million orders daily with a 100+ member team of IIT-trained engineers and data scientists.
Anchorage backed Qi Cap early, recognising the potential for AI-native investing to disrupt traditional asset management well before the theme entered the mainstream.
feat.q: Anchorage is an exceptionally sharp investment team with a deep understanding of capital markets and technology. They understood the potential of our AI-led approach early, well before the opportunity became widely recognised.

faq.a: Anchorage Capital is a SEBI-registered Category II Alternative Investment Fund (registration IN/AIF2/21-22/1003), founded by Rohit Kothari and in operation since 2022. It invests across growth companies in India, largely in the unlisted private space and selectively in listed companies.

The fund is managed by Anchorage Alpha Investments Advisor Private Limited. The sponsor is Rohit Kothari, the trustee is Orbis Trusteeship Services Private Limited and the compliance officer is Bhaven Jain.

faq.q: What kind of companies does Anchorage invest in?
faq.a: Anchorage is a provider of growth capital. Every investment shares one theme: businesses that are unique in their space, with a decisive moat, backed by exceptional founders. Its approach: growth is essential, moats create value, management matters, crowds kill alpha, returns come first and familiarity reduces risk.

faq.q: Which companies has Anchorage invested in?
faq.a: Key investments include Nxtra Data, Meril Life Sciences, Neysa Networks, Precision Wires, ACE Insurance Brokers, Enviro Infra Engineers, Thriveni Earthmovers, Qi Cap, Inox Clean Energy, Caliber Mining & Logistics, GREW Solar and Qucev, among others.

faq.q: How many schemes does Anchorage Capital have?
faq.a: Anchorage Capital has three schemes: Scheme I (inception May 2022), Scheme II (inception September 2023) and Scheme III (inception October 2025). Across its schemes the fund manages a collective ~US$389mn, ₹3,736 crore.

faq.q: Who is the founder of Anchorage?
faq.a: Rohit Kothari is the Founder and Executive Chairman of Anchorage Alpha. A Chartered Accountant with an MBA from Babson College, he built and scaled Aroni Chemicals and Gwalior Chemicals, and founded Antique Stock Broking Limited in 2008. Anchorage began as the Kothari family office, which has more than 25 years of value-driven investing behind it.

faq.q: Can anyone invest in Anchorage Capital?
faq.a: No. Units of Anchorage Capital are offered solely by private placement to eligible investors pursuant to a confidential placement memorandum. This website is for information only and is not an offer or solicitation. Eligible investors can write to investor@anchoragealpha.com.
Anchorage Alpha is at 209/210, 2nd Floor, Arcadia Building, NCPA Marg, Nariman Point, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400021. Telephone: 022-40198600.

faq.q: How can an investor raise a grievance?
faq.a: Investors can raise a grievance through SEBI SCORES at https://scores.sebi.gov.in/ or through the Online Dispute Resolution Portal at https://smartodr.in/.

defs.note: Terms used on this website and in fund documents. These are summaries for convenience; the scheme documents and applicable regulations prevail.
items: Alternative Investment Fund (AIF)

A privately pooled investment vehicle established in India that collects funds from investors for investing in accordance with a defined investment policy, and is registered with SEBI under the SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012.
Category II AIF

An AIF that does not fall under Category I or Category III and does not undertake leverage or borrowing other than to meet day-to-day operational requirements, as permitted under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations. Private equity and growth capital funds are typically Category II AIFs.
SEBI
The Securities and Exchange Board of India, the regulator of India's securities markets and of all Alternative Investment Funds.
Scheme
A separate investment programme launched under the fund, with its own investors, commitments and terms. Anchorage Capital has three schemes: Scheme I, Scheme II and Scheme III.
Sponsor
The person who sets up the AIF and makes a continuing interest commitment to it. The sponsor of Anchorage Capital is Rohit Kothari.
Investment Manager
The entity appointed to manage the investments of the fund and its schemes. For Anchorage Capital this is Anchorage Alpha Investments Advisor Private Limited.
Trustee

The independent entity that holds the fund's assets in trust for the benefit of investors and oversees the investment manager. For Anchorage Capital this is Orbis Trusteeship Services Private Limited.
Investor / Contributor / Unitholder
A person or entity that invests in the fund by making a capital commitment under a binding contribution agreement, and holds units of a scheme.
Capital commitment
The total amount an investor agrees to contribute to a scheme over its life, called in stages as investments are made.
Drawdown
A request by the investment manager for investors to pay in a portion of their capital commitment, usually to fund an investment or fund expenses.
Net Asset Value (NAV)
The value of a scheme's investments and other assets, less its liabilities, as determined under the applicable valuation norms.
Private Placement Memorandum (PPM)
The confidential offer document of a scheme that sets out its strategy, terms, fees, risks and other disclosures. Units of Anchorage Capital are offered only by private placement under a PPM.
KYC
Know Your Customer: the process of verifying the identity and address of every investor, and of any beneficial owner, before and during the investment relationship.
Beneficial Owner
The natural person or persons who ultimately own, control or influence an investor, including those who exercise ultimate effective control over it.
Stewardship
The responsibility of an institutional investor to monitor and engage with the companies it invests in on strategy, performance, risk, capital structure and governance, including by voting.
SEBI SCORES
SEBI Complaints Redress System, SEBI's online platform where investors can lodge and track complaints against registered intermediaries: https://scores.sebi.gov.in/
Online Dispute Resolution (ODR)
The Online Dispute Resolution portal for the Indian securities market, for resolving disputes through online conciliation and arbitration: https://smartodr.in/
